subject.title: Add a mitos snapshot-fork sandbox provider + fork-warmed-lease fan-out

question: Should Crabbox accept Mitos as a supported built-in provider when a contributor commits to regular use, ongoing maintenance, and real create/use/destroy proof?
rationale: The remaining work is not a missing mechanical fan-out fix: it determines whether the project will own a new provider’s isolation claims, pool/auth semantics, lifecycle contract, and maintenance burden.

options.title: Sponsor a supported Mitos provider
options.body: Approve a scoped adapter proposal once a regular user commits to ownership and supplies redacted live create/use/destroy evidence with clean teardown.

options.title: Keep fan-out provider-neutral
options.body: Retain the existing checkpoint fan-out capability and defer Mitos-specific support until a durable provider owner appears.

options.title: Request a narrower discovery proposal
options.body: Ask for a design and live prototype that proves the adapter lifecycle before committing to a permanent supported-provider contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a supported Mitos provider
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped adapter proposal once a regular user commits to ownership and supplies redacted live create/use/destroy evidence with clean teardown.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent public comment defines the repository’s willingness and conditions for accepting additional providers.
